metadata.title: Ribbon Fiber Optic Cable, 12F to 3456F | Vocom
metadata.description: Rollable and flat ribbon fiber optic cable, 12F to 3456F, on Fujikura preform glass, build-to-order, 6 to 8 weeks standard, up to 10 weeks for hyperscale and custom routes.

attributes.text: Indoor and outdoor fiber cable supply
Ribbon Fiber Optic Cable for Indoor and Outdoor Networks, 12F to 6912F

Rollable and flat ribbon in counts from 12F to 6912F, including 1728F dielectric on G.652D or G.657A1, built for both indoor data center trunks and outdoor duct-limited routes. Sourced build-to-order from tier 1 manufacturers using Fujikura preform glass, delivered in 6 to 8 weeks, with 2 to 3 week expedited air freight available.
Need a different spec? We also build to custom order.

Ribbon cable groups fibers into flat arrays so they can be spliced twelve at a time instead of one at a time. Above roughly 288F it stops being a preference and starts being the only way the count fits the duct and the splice window. Rollable ribbon goes further, flexing along its length so the same duct carries close to double.
GYFDXPH, e-ribbon rollable, flat ribbon, central tube ribbon
Loose tube stranded ribbon, central tube ribbon, rollable ribbon
HDPE, dielectric or armored, water blocking, aramid yarn
Duct, direct burial, data center backbone
6 to 8 weeks from PO, up to 10 weeks for custom builds
Low counts for distribution, high counts where duct space is the constraint. Specified per route and supplied to order.

transforms.value: Ribbon and High Fiber Count Cable

attributes.text: Build-to-order: specified to your route, count and jacket, not off a fixed shelf.
Fujikura preform glass: tier 1 manufacturing, consistent quality.
Lead times that move: supply when domestic loose-tube is quoted months out.
Import/export handled: documentation, customs and delivery coordinated.
Founded in 1998: a supplier that also runs networks.
What is the difference between rollable and flat ribbon?

Flat ribbon holds twelve fibers rigid in a plane. Rollable ribbon lets the array flex along its length, so it packs into a smaller cable diameter. At 20mm OD, flat ribbon carries 432F and rollable carries 864F. Both splice on the same mass fusion machine.
What is the highest count you supply?

6912F. The 6912F ribbon spec is available at 38.0mm OD and 1064 kg per km (LSZH), built as 432 ribbons of sixteen fibers on G.657A1 or G.657A2. The 1728F dielectric spec remains available too, at 28.4mm OD and 482 kg per km, built as 144 ribbons of twelve fibers on G.652D.
Is ribbon cable compatible with our existing flat ribbon splices?
Yes. Rollable ribbon is designed to splice against flat ribbon without error, and twelve-fiber compatibility is confirmed.
6 to 8 weeks from PO, up to 10 weeks for custom builds. Domestic ribbon at high count is frequently quoted in months, sometimes longer where a manufacturer has pre-existing contract commitments.
What is rollable ribbon fiber cable?

Rollable ribbon fiber cable is ribbon that flexes along its length instead of staying flat, which lets the same duct carry close to double the fiber count of flat ribbon. Vocom sources rollable ribbon cable from 12F up to 6912F on G.657A1 or G.657A2, build to order on Fujikura preform glass, with standard delivery in 6 to 8 weeks.
Need a Fiber Built to Your Exact Specification?
Fiber count, jacket, rating and connector, we can source and build any fiber optic cable to match your spec.
